proposed_source_policy.status: DRAFT_PENDING_PRODUCT_DECISION (not approved; the safety defaults below are proposals)
proposed_source_policy.q1_committed_allowed_sources: PROPOSAL: only a structured, scoped, versioned, time-stamped platform order/logistics fact (S4-class) may produce COMMITTED. Nothing available today qualifies.
proposed_source_policy.q2_expected_allowed_sources: PROPOSAL: an owner-approved shop policy (S6-class) with store binding + version + effective date may produce EXPECTED; alternatively a structured platform estimate (S4-class) if the platform exposes one. Requires the product decision to name the basis.
proposed_source_policy.q4_conflict_handling: PROPOSAL: conflicting sources inside one scope resolve to UNKNOWN (no precedence invention); a decided precedence order must come from the product decision.
proposed_source_policy.q5_missing_or_unverifiable_identity: PROPOSAL: fail closed to UNKNOWN; no cross-store/account/order substitution, no default.
proposed_source_policy.q6_expired_sources: PROPOSAL: a source without a freshness signal is treated as NOT usable for COMMITTED; expiry must be explicit per source (field + semantics).
proposed_source_policy.q7_observed_vs_business_time: PROPOSAL: observed_at (Main ingestion) is observation metadata only and never presented as the business occurrence time; business time must come from the source field itself.
proposed_source_policy.q8_precision: PROPOSAL: minute-level precision required for COMMITTED; date-level accepted for EXPECTED only if the product decision allows it and the output states the granularity.
proposed_source_policy.q9_timezone: PROPOSAL: the source must carry an explicit IANA timezone or an offset; if missing, the fact is UNKNOWN (no local-timezone assumption).
proposed_source_policy.q10_fact_dto_fields: PROPOSAL: { merchant_id, store_id, platform_account_id, order_ref, kind: COMMITTED|EXPECTED, business_time (ISO + tz), precision: DATE|MINUTE, source_id, source_version, observed_at, freshness (valid_until), provenance } — and the rule/provenance must name the producer.
